dialogue_assist.doc: M2-UI-25 (intro audit 5; docs/kb/tech/ui.md section 'Dialogue assist'): the continue glyph, the backlog and auto-advance, attached to every DialogueBox by DialogueAssist.attach (game/ui/dialogue_assist/). glyph: the gold chevron at the bottom right of the box's panel (inset right_px, bottom_px from its corner; half_width_px wide each side, height_px tall, line_px stroke, node_px the lamp diamond above it, node_gap_px between them) shown while a fully revealed line waits for Confirm; it bobs bob_px down and back every bob_sec (reduced motion: still). auto: with the Accessibility setting dialogue_auto On, a fully revealed line advances by itself after base_sec + per_char_sec x its characters (never while choices are up or the backlog is open; never a line with no text). max_lines: the session backlog keeps this many of the latest lines. subtitles (M2-UI-30, SubtitleStyle): the box follows the text size; the speaker's name takes name_variation's size and the line body_variation's (or its sung variation's) from the scaled theme; every speaker's name takes name_role (a speaker_roles entry may give one speaker another role) and the line body_role; test_subtitles.gd checks that every role in use stays apart from the others and readable for every colour vision. The palette has no four hero colours that stay apart under deuteranopia, protanopia and tritanopia (best Oklab distance 0.072 against a 0.1 floor), so names are not colour-coded per hero: the name says who speaks; a backing in backing_role at the Accessibility 'Subtitle backing' alpha sits behind the text inside the panel. action: the remappable backlog action (added to the InputMap when missing, through FieldInput.add_actions; keys by OS.find_keycode_from_string name, joy_buttons by JoyButton value, 3 = Y).

voice_over.doc: M2-UI-100: narration and #vo lines read as subtitles. The panel rests height_px tall, bottom_px above the screen edge (the lower letterbox band in a cutscene is 0.11 of 1080 = 119 px), at panel_alpha; the line is outlined outline_px in outline_role at outline_alpha. Spoken lines keep the scene panel.

dialogue_backlog.doc: M2-UI-25: the Backlog page (DialogueBacklogPage, a FieldSubmenu: scrim, caustics, the tree paused while open). Rects are x, y, w, h at the 1920 x 1080 reference, multiples of 3. panel: the framed panel with its banner title and help line. list: the scrolled area of lines; each line is the speaker's name (HeaderLabel in focus_gold; none for narration) then its text (BodyLabel), name_gap_px between them and entry_gap_px between lines. It opens scrolled to the latest line. ui_up / ui_down scroll step_px, page keys page_fraction of the list's height, the mouse wheel wheel_px. track: the thin scroll track right of the list (offset_px from its right edge, width_px wide, min_thumb_px the least thumb). dim_alpha darkens everything under the page (the theme's panel_low swatch at that alpha), so the box's own line never reads through the panel. canvas_layer: over the cutscene overlay (32), under the Settings hub (66).
